title: Dispositioning a sanctions alert

steps.title: Open the highest-scoring alert from the queue
Compare date of birth, country and gender
Check the date of birth against the passport on file
Record the false positive disposition and rationale
Close the alert and release the payment
Return to the queue for the next alert

decisions: If the date of birth and the country both differ and the identity document confirms it, disposition the alert as a false positive; if any two of name, date of birth or country match, escalate to the MLRO and do not release the payment.
A similar but differently spelled name is marked partial, never no match, because of transliteration.
warnings: Do not add a customer to the good-guy list after a first false positive; only after QA signs off a second one, or a real match could be suppressed later.
Never release a held payment yourself once an alert is escalated to the MLRO.
openQuestions: The current turnaround time for alerts escalated to the MLRO: Nadia will confirm it with the MLRO's office.
